text:
Cheers front-counter team,
Before opening, our lead trainer brought up a concern about staff briefings.

I want to keep this simple and steady for the shift. Please make sure every handoff starts with the key welfare notes, the traveler's check-in status, and any special handling requests already in the file. If anything feels unclear, pause and ask the senior coordinator before you move the case along. Clear, calm communication helps us protect the animals and keeps the desk running smoothly for everyone.

For today, please be careful to keep all guidance consistent at the counter and in the back office. <<FACT F017>> Use the same language when explaining airport pet services, and avoid giving extra detail that might confuse the traveler. If a case needs a follow-up, flag it right away so the next person can pick it up without delay. The goal is to give each family a predictable and reassuring experience from first contact to departure.

We also had a reminder from the lead trainer about capacity planning. <<FACT F012>> That means we need to watch the queue closely, confirm each booking against the current handling flow, and be honest with travelers if a request needs review before approval. Please stay attentive to animal comfort, document changes as soon as they happen, and keep the tone warm even when the counter is busy. Thanks for the care you bring to the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways each day.
